disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 全量核查硬编码密钥与凭据模式，未发现 API 密钥、云凭据、SSH 私钥、钱包助记词等硬编码值。
checked_items.en: Full scan for hardcoded keys and credential patterns found no hardcoded API keys, cloud credentials, SSH private keys, wallet recovery phrases, or similar values.

checked_items.zh: 核查敏感数据读取面：插件只读写自己生成的 8 位访问密码文件（token/token-lan，存于 $DSH_HOME/dsh-pocket/ 子目录，权限 600）与设置文件（settings.json，权限 600），未读取宿主凭据文件、SSH 私钥或云凭据；Cloudflare Tunnel Token 同样以 0600 存于设置文件，设置页只回显「已配置」布尔值，不回显内容。
checked_items.en: Sensitive data read surface checked: the plugin only reads/writes its own generated 8-character access password files (token/token-lan, stored in the $DSH_HOME/dsh-pocket/ subdirectory, permission 600) and the settings file (settings.json, permission 600). It does not read host credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud credentials; the Cloudflare Tunnel Token is likewise stored in the settings file with 0600, and the settings page only echoes back a 'configured' boolean, never the content.

checked_items.zh: 核查「复制文件内容」远程读取口（2.7.0 起新增）：手机端点复制按钮后由主机读取指定路径文件正文（上限 4MB、二进制拒读），路径支持绝对/家目录/相对三种形式；该口仅在通过访问密码鉴权的入口可达，读取结果写回手机剪贴板，未见批量搜集或外发行为，与声明的移动端文件复制功能一致，判定良性。
checked_items.en: 'Copy file content' remote read endpoint checked (new since 2.7.0): after the user taps the copy button on the mobile endpoint, the host reads the file body at the specified path (up to 4MB, binary files rejected), with absolute/home-directory/relative path forms supported. The endpoint is reachable only through the access-password-authenticated entry, and the read result is written back to the phone's clipboard. No bulk collection or exfiltration behavior was observed; consistent with the declared mobile file-copy feature, judged benign.

checked_items.zh: 核查凭据批量搜集语义（全盘搜索密钥、云账号枚举、钱包资产发现），命中 0。
checked_items.en: Bulk credential collection semantics checked (disk-wide key search, cloud account enumeration, wallet asset discovery): 0 hits.

evidence.zh: 插件读取的敏感数据仅限自己生成的访问密码文件与用户填写的 Tunnel Token：密码文件以 600 权限写入、仅登录验证时比对（lib/index.js:54-67、lib/proxy.mjs:427-432），Tunnel Token 经环境变量传给隧道进程、不进命令行参数、RPC 不回显（lib/tunnel.mjs:452-455、lib/web-rpc.js:363-364），未发现凭据外泄通道。
evidence.en: Sensitive data read by the plugin is limited to its own generated access password files and the user-entered Tunnel Token: the password files are written with permission 600 and compared only during login verification (lib/index.js:54-67, lib/proxy.mjs:427-432); the Tunnel Token is passed to the tunnel process via an environment variable, never in command-line arguments, and never echoed back via RPC (lib/tunnel.mjs:452-455, lib/web-rpc.js:363-364). No credential exfiltration channel was found.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件注册的全部对外文本面：本插件不注册任何供模型调用的工具，只注册设置页签与移动端界面组件，无工具描述文本可投毒。
checked_items.en: All model-facing text surfaces registered by the plugin were checked: the plugin registers no tools callable by the model, only a settings page tab and mobile UI components — no tool description text available for poisoning.

checked_items.zh: 核查 README、CHANGELOG、开发文档、源码注释、界面文案（中英文词典）中的注入措辞（指令覆写、伪造系统消息、诱导读取凭据、诱导安装插件），命中 0。
checked_items.en: README, CHANGELOG, development docs, source comments, and UI copy (Chinese and English dictionaries) were checked for injection phrasing (instruction overrides, forged system messages, luring credential reads, luring plugin installs): 0 hits.

checked_items.zh: 全树扫描未发现任何模型面指令文件（技能说明、代理指令、MCP 配置、编辑器自动化配置等）。
checked_items.en: A full-tree scan found no model-facing instruction files (skill descriptions, agent instructions, MCP configs, editor automation configs, etc.).

checked_items.zh: 核查代理注入网页的三段脚本（浏览器兼容补丁、远程设置信任补丁、桌面端 advanced 模式提示层，lib/proxy.mjs:30-36/86-134/146）：均为静态固定文本，无远程拉取、无指令性内容；未检出任何历史压缩引擎实现，不存在压缩裁剪篡改面。
checked_items.en: The three script segments injected by the proxy into web pages (browser compatibility patch, remote-settings trust patch, desktop advanced-mode hint layer, lib/proxy.mjs:30-36/86-134/146) were checked: all are static fixed text with no remote fetching and no directive content; no historical compression engine implementation was detected, so no compression-truncation tampering surface exists.

evidence.zh: 本插件不注册任何模型可调用的工具，无工具描述文本可投毒；设置页与移动端界面文案经语义审查无注入措辞。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no model-callable tools, so there is no tool description text available for poisoning; settings page and mobile UI copy passed semantic review with no injection phrasing.

evidence.zh: 插件没有任何面向模型的工具描述，不存在诱导模型执行安装、改写配置的文本载体。
evidence.en: The plugin has no model-facing tool descriptions; there is no text vehicle for luring the model into performing installs or rewriting configs.

evidence.zh: 未检出对模型输入守门事件（agent/pre-step）的监听，插件不改写或注入模型看到的用户消息。
evidence.en: Not detected: any listener on model input gate events (agent/pre-step); the plugin does not rewrite or inject into the user messages the model sees.

checked_items.zh: 核查全部源码中的进程调用共 7 处：插件自更新（调用 dsh 命令拉取新版，lib/index.js:221）、自重启（拉起辅助进程等端口释放后重建宿主，lib/restart.js:98）、WSL 局域网 IP 探测（ipconfig，lib/service.mjs:120）、cloudflared 下载解压（tar，lib/tunnel.mjs:302）与隧道进程（lib/tunnel.mjs:452/542）、cloudflared 路径探测（lib/tunnel.mjs:346）——逐处确认参数固定或来自宿主自身启动参数与本机配置文件，无外部输入拼入命令，用途与声明功能一致，判定良性。
checked_items.en: All 7 process invocations in the source were checked: self-update (invoking the dsh command to fetch the new version, lib/index.js:221), self-restart (spawning a helper process to rebuild the host after the port is released, lib/restart.js:98), WSL LAN IP detection (ipconfig, lib/service.mjs:120), cloudflared download and extraction (tar, lib/tunnel.mjs:302) and the tunnel process (lib/tunnel.mjs:452/542), cloudflared path detection (lib/tunnel.mjs:346) — each was confirmed to use fixed parameters or parameters from the host's own startup arguments and local config files, with no external input spliced into commands; purposes match the declared functionality, judged benign.

checked_items.zh: 核查客户端打包产物中的键盘监听（两处）与剪贴板写入（一处）：键盘监听仅比对 Escape 键关闭抽屉，剪贴板写入是「复制文件内容」按钮的落点（内容经主机读取后写入），无键盘记录、无凭据接口调用，判定良性。
checked_items.en: Keyboard listeners (two) and clipboard writes (one) in the client bundle were checked: the keyboard listener only compares the Escape key to close a drawer, and the clipboard write is the landing point of the 'copy file content' button (content written after being read by the host). No keylogging, no credential API calls, judged benign.

checked_items.zh: 核查打包产物与测试文件中的高密度转义文本（两处）：均为中文注释/测试数据的 Unicode 转义形态，非刻意混淆。
checked_items.en: High-density escaped text in the bundle and test files (two spots) was checked: both are Unicode-escaped forms of Chinese comments/test data, not deliberate obfuscation.

checked_items.zh: 核查仓库自带的 GitHub Actions 工作流（release.yml 和 test.yml）：仅触发 npm 测试与手动发版，无外联脚本、无凭据读取，判定良性。
checked_items.en: The repo's bundled GitHub Actions workflows (release.yml and test.yml) were checked: they only trigger npm tests and manual releases, with no outbound scripts and no credential reads, judged benign.

checked_items.zh: 未检出动态执行模式（eval、动态函数构造、Base64 解码即执行）与动态包工具调用。
checked_items.en: Not detected: dynamic execution patterns (eval, dynamic function construction, decode-and-exec Base64) or dynamic package tool invocation.

checked_items.zh: 未检出安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare），依赖均来自 npm 官方源并锁定版本，无浮动的 git 依赖。
checked_items.en: Not detected: install hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare). Dependencies all come from the official npm registry with pinned versions; no floating git dependencies.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 仅含一条插件插入声明，全文无任何 JS 执行标量（!!js），loader 不会在宿主进程求值任意代码。
evidence.en: The patch config cordis.patch.yml contains only one plugin insertion declaration, with no JS execution scalars (!!js) anywhere in the file; the loader will not evaluate arbitrary code in the host process.

evidence.zh: 未检出对动态包工具（cordis_define/cordis_run 类）的调用，插件没有让模型在宿主 vm 里跑代码的接口。
evidence.en: Not detected: any calls to dynamic package tools (cordis_define/cordis_run types); the plugin has no interface for the model to run code in the host vm.

evidence.zh: package.json 无任何安装钩子脚本；依赖均来自 npm 官方源并锁定版本范围，无 git 浮动引用；仓库内 CI 工作流仅做测试与手动发版，无外联下载执行。
evidence.en: package.json has no install hook scripts; dependencies all come from the official npm registry with pinned version ranges, no floating git references; the repo's CI workflows only run tests and manual releases, with no outbound download-and-execute.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了 dsh.client 客户端模块并对打包产物做了专项核查（client/client.js 全文）：键盘监听仅用于 Escape 关闭抽屉、剪贴板仅用于用户主动点击的文件内容复制，无凭据 RPC 调用、无可疑外联，属良性 UI 行为。
evidence.en: The plugin declares the dsh.client client module, and the bundle was specifically reviewed (full text of client/client.js): the keyboard listener is only used for Escape-closes-drawer, the clipboard only for user-initiated file content copy; no credential RPC calls, no suspicious outbound connections — benign UI behavior.

evidence.zh: 未检出子代理提供方注册（registerProvider 类），插件不会把轮次委派给进程外 agent 产品。
evidence.en: Not detected: sub-agent provider registration (registerProvider types); the plugin will not delegate turns to out-of-process agent products.

evidence.zh: 未检出 dsh 原生持驻注册（后台任务、定时提醒、持久目标、轮次续命监听）；公网隧道自动恢复属用户主动开启功能的延续，与声明一致。
evidence.en: Not detected: dsh native persistence registration (background tasks, scheduled reminders, persistent goals, turn-extension listeners); the public tunnel auto-recovery is a continuation of a user-enabled feature, consistent with the declaration.

checked_items.zh: 枚举了全部网络外联点：npm registry 版本检查（registry.npmjs.org）、cloudflared 二进制下载（官方 GitHub + 清华镜像 + 三个国内加速源，lib/tunnel.mjs:80-87）、公网隧道到 Cloudflare 边缘（trycloudflare.com 或用户自建命名隧道）——均为插件声明功能所需，无未声明端点。
checked_items.en: All outbound network points were enumerated: npm registry version check (registry.npmjs.org), cloudflared binary download (official GitHub + Tsinghua mirror + three China acceleration mirrors, lib/tunnel.mjs:80-87), public tunnel to the Cloudflare edge (trycloudflare.com or a user-created named tunnel) — all required by declared plugin functionality; no undeclared endpoints.

checked_items.zh: 核查了敏感文件读取后编码外发的组合链（读取 → 编码/压缩 → 网络发送），命中 0；「复制文件内容」读取的结果写回手机剪贴板，不经网络外发。
checked_items.en: Combined chains of sensitive-file read followed by encoded exfiltration (read → encode/compress → network send) were checked: 0 hits; the result of the 'copy file content' read is written back to the phone's clipboard and never sent over the network.

checked_items.zh: 核查了 DNS 隧道、Webhook 回调、AI 端点劫持、代理环境变量劫持等带外通道模式，命中 0。
checked_items.en: Out-of-band channel patterns such as DNS tunneling, webhook callbacks, AI endpoint hijacking, and proxy environment variable hijacking were checked: 0 hits.

evidence.zh: 插件读取的敏感数据仅限自己生成的访问密码文件与用户自填的 Tunnel Token；公网隧道暴露的是用户主动开启的访问入口且有密码保护，密码与 Token 不随隧道流量外发，未发现凭据外泄通道。
evidence.en: Sensitive data read by the plugin is limited to its own generated access password files and the user-entered Tunnel Token; the public tunnel exposes a user-initiated access entry that is password-protected, and the password and Token are never exfiltrated with tunnel traffic. No credential exfiltration channel was found.

evidence.zh: 未检出对模型请求路由事件（agent/request、agent/request-error）的监听，也未注册自定义模型适配器，不存在运行时把对话重路由到未声明端点的路径。
evidence.en: Not detected: any listener on model request routing events (agent/request, agent/request-error), and no custom model adapters registered; there is no path for rerouting conversations to undeclared endpoints at runtime.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖清单：运行时依赖仅 qrcode 与 qrcode-terminal（知名稳定库），宿主 SDK 为官方 @deepseek-ai/cordis，构建与发布工具为 esbuild 与 semantic-release 系列，无 typosquatting、无与 dsh 生态命名撞车的可疑包、无 git 浮动引用。
checked_items.en: Dependency manifest checked: runtime dependencies are only qrcode and qrcode-terminal (well-known stable libraries); the host SDK is the official @deepseek-ai/cordis; build and release tooling is esbuild and the semantic-release family. No typosquatting, no suspicious packages colliding with dsh ecosystem names, no floating git references.

checked_items.zh: 核查挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml：只做插件插入（insert），未触碰沙箱/审批/权限等安全配置行，无 disabled 降权、无环境变量降权写法。
checked_items.en: The patch config cordis.patch.yml was checked: it only performs a plugin insert and does not touch security-related config lines such as sandbox/approval/permissions; no disabled downgrades, no environment-variable downgrade patterns.

checked_items.zh: 未检出对安全事件（工具预执行、审批请求）的抢先监听，未检出注入/拦截配置改写。
checked_items.en: Not detected: pre-emptive listeners on security events (tool pre-execution, approval requests), and no injection/interception config rewrites.

checked_items.zh: 发布流程为常规 npm publish（GitHub Actions 手动 workflow_dispatch 触发 semantic-release），无安装期远程脚本执行。
checked_items.en: The release process is a regular npm publish (semantic-release triggered via manual GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch); no install-time remote script execution.

checked_items.zh: 版本对比：与上版 2.1.4 相比，manifest 能力声明结构无变化（仍为 bundle patch + client），无升级自动激活新增面。
checked_items.en: Version comparison: compared with the previous version 2.1.4, the manifest capability declaration structure is unchanged (still bundle patch + client); no upgrade-activated new surfaces.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅含一条 insert 声明（cordis.patch.yml:3-5），未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，无 disabled 降权、无环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config contains only one insert declaration (cordis.patch.yml:3-5) and does not touch security-related config lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; no disabled downgrades, no environment-variable downgrade patterns.

evidence.zh: 未检出对工具预执行或审批请求等安全事件的优先监听，插件不介入审批链，不存在截断可能。
evidence.en: Not detected: priority listeners on security events such as tool pre-execution or approval requests; the plugin does not intervene in the approval chain, so no truncation is possible.

evidence.zh: 与上版 2.1.4 对比，manifest 能力声明（bundle patch + client）无突变，未出现升级自动激活新增面。
evidence.en: Compared with the previous version 2.1.4, the manifest capability declaration (bundle patch + client) shows no abrupt changes; no upgrade-activated new surfaces appeared.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入或拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其永久挂起的路径。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite injection or interception configs; there is no path for appending a required service to security plugins to keep them permanently pending.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件是否启动网络服务：插件启动一个反向代理（默认监听 0.0.0.0:3081）把手机流量转发到本机 dsh web，并可选建立 cloudflared 公网隧道——这是插件核心功能（手机访问），已在能力声明与文档中明示。
checked_items.en: Whether the plugin starts network services was checked: the plugin starts a reverse proxy (listening on 0.0.0.0:3081 by default) that forwards phone traffic to the local dsh web, and optionally establishes a cloudflared public tunnel — this is the plugin's core feature (phone access) and is explicitly stated in the capability declaration and documentation.

checked_items.zh: 核查该服务的安全设计：公网/局域网独立 8 位密码（加密随机数生成、可自定义）、公网密码默认每次开启轮换、登录失败三层速率限制（单 IP 锁、全局锁、锁定窗口，lib/proxy.mjs:173-218）、开启公网前强制免责声明且服务端校验（lib/web-rpc.js:130-137）、WebSocket 同样鉴权并并入限速（lib/proxy.mjs:1042-1081）、Host 分类 fail closed（陌生域名一律按公网处理，lib/proxy.mjs:278-293）、Host 头伪造按 TCP 源地址收紧（lib/proxy.mjs:334-344）、常量时间密码比较、会话 cookie 绑定进程级随机密钥、CLI 模式自 2.10.3 起默认也带密码——防护措施与暴露面匹配。
checked_items.en: The service's security design was checked: separate 8-character passwords for public/LAN access (crypto-random generation, customizable), public password rotated by default on each enablement, three-layer login rate limiting (per-IP lock, global lock, lockout window, lib/proxy.mjs:173-218), mandatory disclaimer with server-side verification before enabling public access (lib/web-rpc.js:130-137), WebSocket also authenticated and included in rate limiting (lib/proxy.mjs:1042-1081), Host classification fails closed (unknown domains always treated as public, lib/proxy.mjs:278-293), Host header spoofing tightened against the TCP source address (lib/proxy.mjs:334-344), constant-time password comparison, session cookies bound to a process-level random key, and CLI mode defaulting to a password since 2.10.3 — the protections match the exposure surface.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本环境无动态沙箱产物），运行时行为基于静态分析结论。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic sandbox artifact in this environment); runtime behavior conclusions are based on static analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件启动的反向代理属声明功能。相对宿主原生 web 服务，该代理为公网/局域网访问额外加了密码认证、速率限制与免责声明确认，未发现超越声明的无认证暴露面。
evidence.en: The reverse proxy started by the plugin is a declared feature. Compared to the host's native web service, the proxy additionally adds password authentication, rate limiting, and disclaimer confirmation for public/LAN access; no undeclared unauthenticated exposure surface was found.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核对通过：包名、版本、仓库地址与任务卡一致；dsh 字段声明确认（bundle patch + client）。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: package name, version, and repository URL match the task card; the dsh field declaration was confirmed (bundle patch + client).

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：预扫 22 条机械命中全部逐条核查并判定为良性功能用法，未检出动态执行、凭据窃取、未声明外联等危险模式。
summary.en: Static scan complete: all 22 mechanical pre-scan hits were individually reviewed and judged benign functional usage; no dangerous patterns such as dynamic execution, credential theft, or undeclared outbound connections were detected.

summary.zh: 行为分析完成：进程调用、网络外联、文件读写均与声明功能对应；无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无敏感路径读取、无凭据外发。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis complete: process invocations, network egress, and file reads/writes all correspond to declared functionality; no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no sensitive path reads, no credential exfiltration.

target.en: dsh-pocket@2.10.3#eb255032991949d95c896f762e681c19e622cbdc (repo root, full audit); previous version 2.1.4@663276bc baseline used for version comparison

limits.zh:
1) 本环境未提供动态沙箱产物（l4-sandbox.json 不存在），DG-L4 动态验证未执行，运行时行为基于静态分析结论。
2) package.json 的 dsh 声明不含显式能力清单字段，插件能力（网络、进程调用、文件读写）由代码实测推断并填入声明面，声明面与实测面一致。
3) context/manifest.json 所列 57 个文件全部在源码树中可定位：代码、配置、文档类文件已核查；docs/ 下 7 张图片为二进制多媒体未逐字节解读；package-lock.json（约 228KB）按安装钩子与依赖名核查、未逐字通读。
4) 机械预扫 22 条命中逐条裁决均为良性：CI 工作流两处（DSH-X07/DG-R3-59，.github/workflows/release.yml 与 .github/workflows/test.yml）为常规 npm 测试与手动发版流程；键盘监听与剪贴板写入六处（DSH-X05/DG-R3-57，client/client.js:237、client/client.js:421、client/client.js:422、client/mobile/fileGuard.ts:36、client/mobile/fileGuard.ts:39、client/mobile/fileGuard.ts:40、client/mobile/MobileNavOverlay.tsx:99）为 Escape 关抽屉与「复制文件内容」的 UI 逻辑；转义密度两处（DSH-X08/DG-R3-60，client/client.js:408 与 test/service.test.js:703）为中文注释/测试数据的 Unicode 转义；进程调用七处（DSH-X03/DG-R3-55，lib/index.js:13、lib/restart.js:14、lib/restart.js:44（字符串字面量非实际调用）、lib/service.mjs:12、lib/tunnel.mjs:9、LOCAL-DEV.md:48（文档代码块）、test/cli-auth.test.js:10（测试代码））参数固定或来自宿主自身启动参数；curl 命令四处（DSH-C05/DG-R4-53，LOCAL-DEV.md:58、LOCAL-DEV.md:59、LOCAL-DEV.md:68、LOCAL-DEV.md:105）均为开发文档中本机调试命令，非运行时外发。均未形成发现项。
5) 「复制文件内容」远程读取口为本版相对基线 2.1.4 的新增功能（2.7.0 起加入）：可读取任意路径下不超过 4MB 的文本文件，仅在通过访问密码鉴权的入口可达、结果写回手机剪贴板，与移动端文件复制声明一致，判定良性；manifest 能力声明结构相对基线无变化，无升级自动激活面。
6) 上版 2.1.4@663276bc 基线报告为 clean；本版为完整审计（release-full），结论基于当前快照全量核查，与基线结论一致。
limits.en:
1) This environment provides no dynamic sandbox artifact (l4-sandbox.json does not exist); DG-L4 dynamic verification was not executed, and runtime behavior conclusions are based on static analysis.
2) The dsh declaration in package.json contains no explicit capability list field; plugin capabilities (network, process invocation, file reads/writes) were inferred from actual code behavior and filled into the declared surface, which matches the observed surface.
3) All 57 files listed in context/manifest.json are locatable in the source tree: code, config, and documentation files were reviewed; the 7 images under docs/ are binary multimedia and were not interpreted byte by byte; package-lock.json (~228KB) was checked for install hooks and dependency names, not read word by word.
4) All 22 mechanical pre-scan hits were individually adjudicated as benign: two CI workflow hits (DSH-X07/DG-R3-59, .github/workflows/release.yml and .github/workflows/test.yml) are routine npm test and manual release flows; six keyboard listener and clipboard write hits (DSH-X05/DG-R3-57, client/client.js:237, client/client.js:421, client/client.js:422, client/mobile/fileGuard.ts:36, client/mobile/fileGuard.ts:39, client/mobile/fileGuard.ts:40, client/mobile/MobileNavOverlay.tsx:99) are Escape-closes-drawer and 'copy file content' UI logic; two escape density hits (DSH-X08/DG-R3-60, client/client.js:408 and test/service.test.js:703) are Unicode escapes of Chinese comments/test data; seven process invocation hits (DSH-X03/DG-R3-55, lib/index.js:13, lib/restart.js:14, lib/restart.js:44 (string literal, not an actual invocation), lib/service.mjs:12, lib/tunnel.mjs:9, LOCAL-DEV.md:48 (doc code block), test/cli-auth.test.js:10 (test code)) use fixed parameters or parameters from the host's own startup arguments; four curl command hits (DSH-C05/DG-R4-53, LOCAL-DEV.md:58, LOCAL-DEV.md:59, LOCAL-DEV.md:68, LOCAL-DEV.md:105) are all local debugging commands in development docs, not runtime exfiltration. None became findings.
5) The 'copy file content' remote read endpoint is a new feature relative to the 2.1.4 baseline (added in 2.7.0): it can read text files of up to 4MB at arbitrary paths, is reachable only through the access-password-authenticated entry, and writes results back to the phone's clipboard, consistent with the mobile file-copy declaration — judged benign; the manifest capability declaration structure is unchanged relative to the baseline, with no upgrade-activated surfaces.
6) The previous version's 2.1.4@663276bc baseline report was clean; this version is a full audit (release-full), and the conclusion is based on a full scan of the current snapshot, consistent with the baseline conclusion.
